title: fq-release/1 — one signature over a whole release
description: fq-release.json: a single signed document naming every file of a release with its sha256 and size, so a consumer verifies ONE signature (against a fingerprint pinned out of band) and then hashes bytes, instead of trusting N independent attestation lines and hoping the set is complete. Because index-kK.json and every attestations/*.jsonl are themselves covered, their contents — including per-expert digests — become trusted data under that one signature. Same envelope shape as fq-attestation/1. Emitted and checked by fq_release.py.

release.description: human-readable release name, e.g. 'GLM-5.2-EXL3-FQ k3 base 0.1.0'

repo.description: artifact repo the release was published to, if any

manifest_sha256.description: digest of fq-manifest.json in this release, duplicated for convenience

files.description: path relative to the release root -> digest and size. The set is exhaustive: a file not listed here is not part of the release, and a consumer should treat unlisted files as uncovered by the signature.
